title: Independent product probability mass function
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite index type, let $\alpha_i$ be a finite type for each $i\in\iota$, and let $p_i$ be a probability mass function on $\alpha_i$. The independent product probability mass function on tuples $x=(x_i)_{i\in\iota}$ assigns mass $\prod_{i\in\iota}p_i(x_i)$ to $x$.
hypotheses_covered: For each $i$, $p_i$ is a probability mass function on $\alpha_i$.
